summary: Delete a known record. This helper only generates code; it never auto-runs.
purpose: Use this when you need a reviewed server-side starter for a delete flow and want the warning documented with the code.
learningGoals: Treat destructive requests with stronger caution than ordinary writes.

explanation: Delete is the most destructive beginner-facing module, so it remains code-only and heavily documented. The generated code is a review aid, not a runnable in-browser shortcut.
commonMistakes: Deleting a production record while trying to learn the API shape.
Assuming an OData delete should be exposed directly from a browser helper.
Skipping record verification before running destructive code.
expectedResult: You get a server-side starter snippet with clear warnings, but the playground will not run it live.
